I haven't written the roadmap, because the file it would go to already exists and holds a different roadmap.

`specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec-roadmap.md` is titled **"Filing alerts — roadmap"**. It carries the roadmap header, and its `Source` is "your partner's words, 2026-09-14", with no spec. So it is a live roadmap for a separate project, not one derived from `sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md`. It wasn't in `git ls-files`, so it's untracked, and my earlier header scan missed it. Writing to that name would overwrite it, so I've stopped.

I have your ranking (the order I listed the outcomes, one known-progression track). The only thing missing is a filename.

**Which name should this roadmap use?** I suggest `specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-roadmap.md`. It doesn't collide with anything, and it still reads as belonging to the spec. Once you confirm a name, or give a different one, I'll write the roadmap there with the stages committed in your order and bring the partition back for approval before Stage 1.

Separately, you may want to look at the Filing alerts roadmap. If it's still active, it would be resumed in its own session. If it was misnamed, renaming it would clear up the confusion. I won't touch it either way.
